evals.prompt: We have a B2B analytics product and a small budget. Which traction channel should we test first?
evals.expected_output: Runs the bullseye framework: brainstorm the 19 channels, estimate reach, cost, and conversion, place them in rings, and pick one inner-ring channel to test with at least 100 data points.
assertions: Places channels in three bullseye rings
Selects one inner-ring channel to focus on
Requires at least 100 data points to evaluate
Evaluates channels on CAC, scalability, and sustainability

evals.prompt: Can we test content, SEO, and paid ads all at once?
evals.expected_output: Advises against testing three channels simultaneously. Focus is needed to get clean signal.
assertions: Advises against testing multiple channels at once
Explains that focus is needed for clean signal

evals.prompt: Our content channel has a CAC of $45 and compounds. Should we pull the bullseye?
evals.expected_output: Confirms the channel passes CAC, scalability, and sustainability, then recommends pulling the bullseye and scaling it until saturation.
assertions: Recommends pulling the bullseye on a passing channel
